token.title: Lumin Account Authentication
token.description:
Paste your token data from the Lumin portal.

1. Go to {portal_url} and log in
2. Open browser DevTools (F12)
3. Go to Application → Local Storage → portal.luminsmart.com
4. Click the auth entry and copy the entire Value field

You can paste the full JSON blob or just the access_token string. The refresh token (included in the JSON) keeps the integration authenticated indefinitely.
